name: pk-it-export-tax
description: Use this skill whenever asked about how Pakistani freelancers and IT exporters are taxed on income earned from foreign clients. Trigger on phrases like "Pakistan freelancer tax", "IT export tax Pakistan", "PSEB tax", "Upwork Fiverr tax Pakistan", "0.25% IT export", "software export tax Pakistan", "remittance tax freelancer". Covers the concessional final-tax regime on exported IT and IT-enabled services, the PSEB registration benefit, the banking-channel/remittance requirement, and the difference vs ordinary business income. ALWAYS read this before any Pakistan IT-export work.
